verdict.rationale: Metronome documents some built-in event-driven automation: auto-recharge or gated access when prepaid credits run out, webhooks fired on events such as a threshold being reached, and automatic Stripe invoice creation when an invoice finalizes. These are fixed billing behaviors and outbound notifications rather than a general facility for users to author their own rules. missing for 10: a general user-definable rules/workflow engine (custom conditions mapped to custom actions), documentation of how thresholds and triggers are configured, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Set up Metronome to allow customers to purchase a batch of credits upfront, with auto-recharge or gated access when credits run out.
Metronome sends an HTTP POST request to that URL when certain events occur, such as a contract being created, a threshold being reached or an invoice being finalized.
when an invoice finalizes at the end of the billing period, Metronome automatically creates a corresponding invoice in Stripe to collect payment.
